n, B = map(int, input().split())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))

diff_list = []
even_count = 0
odd_count = 0

for i in range(n - 1):
    if a[i] % 2 == 0:
        even_count += 1
    else:
        odd_count += 1
    if even_count == odd_count:
        diff_list.append(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]))

diff_list.sort()

used_count = 0
for diff in diff_list:
    if diff <= B:
        B -= diff
        used_count += 1
    else:
        break

print(used_count)
</translated_code>
